map.依据立位后前位胸片测量胸膜间距，采用 Rhea 法估算气胸肺压缩百分比: Measures pleural distances on an upright PA chest film and estimates pneumothorax lung compression percentage by the Rhea method
map.📖 查看「气胸肺压缩%估计器 使用指南」: 📖 View the Pneumothorax Lung Compression Estimator user guide
map.气胸肺压缩比 ≈ 三处肋间测量平均距离 × 10（上限 100%）；压缩 小于2: Pneumothorax compression ratio ~ mean of three interpleural measurements x 10 (capped at 100%); compression <20% and asymptomatic can be observed with high-concentration oxygen; secondary or tension pneumothorax needs chest tube drainage or urgent decompression.
map.在胸片上测量三处胸膜间距(cm)：A=肺尖顶到胸膜顶；B=上半肺野中点胸膜间距；: Measure three pleural distances (cm) on the film: A = apex of lung to pleural apex; B = pleural distance at the midpoint of the upper lung field; C = midpoint of the lower lung field
map.立即排气(粗针)+引流，勿等影像: Immediate decompression (large-bore needle) plus drainage; do not wait for imaging
map.提示：Rhea法公式：压缩% ≈ (A+B+C)/3 × 10。公式为估算值，大: Note: Rhea formula - compression % ~ (A+B+C)/3 x 10. It is an estimate; error grows in large pneumothorax (complete collapse). Tension pneumothorax is a clinical diagnosis and must be treated immediately without waiting for imaging. A 2 cm pleural distance corresponds to about 20% compression. Clinical reference only.
map.a=b=c=2cm，均值 2，压缩≈2×10=20%：临界，观察或细管引流。: a=b=c=2 cm, mean 2, compression ~ 2 x 10 = 20%: borderline, observe or use a small-bore drain.
map.压缩>20% 且呼吸困难→优先胸腔闭式引流。: Compression >20% with dyspnea -> chest tube drainage preferred.
map.径线法为粗略估计，CT 体积法更准；临床以症状为先。: The linear method is a rough estimate; CT volumetry is more accurate; symptoms come first clinically.
map.无症状原发性可观察，继发性/症状者引流。: Asymptomatic primary can be observed; secondary or symptomatic cases need drainage.
map.气胸(肺压缩%)估计器，依据胸片测量胸膜间距采用Rhea法估算自发性气胸肺压缩百: Pneumothorax (Lung Compression %) Estimator uses pleural distances on chest film with the Rhea method to estimate compression percentage in spontaneous pneumothorax and suggests management. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.请填写 A/B/C 三处胸膜间距（≥0 的有效数字）；空值或负值不会被当作 0: Enter valid pleural distances at A/B/C (≥0); blanks or negatives are never treated as 0 to produce a compression estimate.
map.三处胸膜间距均为 0，无法估计气胸压缩比例；请核对测量值。: All three pleural distances are 0, so the pneumothorax size cannot be estimated; verify the measurements.
map.创伤性气胸需先按 ATLS 评估合并伤，排查开放性/张力性气胸与血气胸；多数需胸: Traumatic pneumothorax requires ATLS assessment of associated injuries and exclusion of open/tension pneumothorax and hemopneumothorax; most need tube thoracostomy, with emergency/trauma team review.
map.参考：本页按 Rhea 法估算（本页估算），BTS 指南以胸膜间距 ≥2 cm: Reference: this page uses the Rhea method (estimate); BTS guidance distinguishes size at a pleural distance ≥2 cm, and CT is more accurate; imaging/clinical review required.
map.气胸肺压缩比 ≈ 三处肋间测量平均距离 × 10（Rhea 法，上限 100%；: Pneumothorax size ≈ mean of three intercostal pleural distances × 10 (Rhea method, capped at 100%; page estimate, imaging/clinical review required). If compression is <20% and asymptomatic, observe with high-concentration oxygen; secondary, traumatic or tension pneumothorax requires tube thoracostomy or emergency decompression. BTS guidance distinguishes size at a pleural distance ≥2 cm, and CT is more accurate.
